vr.label: Genola — Integral / VR Missions (1999)
vr.episode: Metal Gear Solid: Integral / VR Missions (1999, original PlayStation incarnation)
vr.prompt: Create ONE isolated full-body production reference sprite of GENOLA from the ORIGINAL Metal Gear Solid: Integral / VR Missions (1999 PlayStation version), based strictly on the two supplied actual-game screenshots. The main reference shows two identical giant Genome soldiers with their whole bodies and rifles visible; isolate ONLY ONE of those giant soldiers, preferably the right-hand giant's stance, and reproduce his original design. The second tiny screenshot is the official Konami Integral Variety 13 image, only as identity corroboration. Do not include Solid Snake, Meryl, the second giant, stage geometry, interface, grid, watermark, captions, or text. Character must be a single whole subject from top of balaclava to soles, holding ONE complete FAMAS across his body in both black mitten-like gloves. Keep a front / slight three-quarter view like the reference, with the FAMAS muzzle pointing screen-right; never truncate either end of the rifle. Keep the original PS1 low-polygon angular silhouette and simple color-block textures: pale off-white balaclava with small dark eye holes, NO exposed realistic face, dark black raised neck collar, off-white winter parka with long squared split skirt hem, angular white trousers, dark gray/black low blocky boots, dark belt and simple rectangular belt pouches, plain dark vertical chest straps, black gloves. Match the coat's original muted greenish shadow cast as seen in the game; do NOT invent a detailed modern camouflage pattern or realistic fabric weave. Preserve the simple faceted geometry of shoulders, elbows, thighs, coat tails, and feet. Do NOT turn him into a Substance remaster, metal robot, photorealistic soldier, anime figure, generic futuristic armor, or a new design. No new badges, pockets, tactical attachments, muzzle effects, lasers, scars, emblems, or machine parts. Reproduce existing visible shapes with careful clear edges; sharp clean raster suitable for inspection, deliberately preserving the original game's low-poly character rather than adding imaginary detail. Entire body and weapon occupy approximately 85 percent of a tall canvas with comfortable transparent margin on all sides. True transparent RGBA background; absolutely no backdrop, ground, floor plane, gradient, colored matte, shadow, lighting aura, border, or checkerboard pixels. This is a source-faithful static adaptation for external review, not a certified one-to-one model and not an animation sheet.

vr.prompt:

Reference3 gives the side/back dorsal protrusion arrangement; preserve that form only where visible naturally from the final pose. Reference4 gives the helmet/back-of-head details. Only the one entire subject and his rifle, no Raiden, Snake, second giant, stage, buildings, screen interface, text, target boxes, light trails or laser beams. True RGBA transparent background, no floor, no shadow plane, no gradient, no glow around the silhouette, no checkerboard pixels and no solid-color background.
